stories.headline: Takaichi prepares for high-stakes Washington visit to meet Trump amid health concerns
stories.summary: PM Takaichi is preparing for her first visit to Washington since taking office, scheduled for next week to meet with Trump. The visit was briefly in doubt after she cancelled some events due to cold symptoms, but she has since recovered and returned to official duties.

stories.headline: Japan becomes first G7 nation to release strategic oil reserves amid Iran conflict
stories.summary: PM Takaichi announced Japan will release stockpiled oil and cap gasoline prices as early as Monday, making Japan the first G7 nation to act unilaterally on oil reserves amid the Iran conflict. Japan holds oil equivalent to about 254 days of domestic demand.

articles.title: Prime Minister Takaichi: Japan will release stockpiled oil

stories.headline: Takaichi's cabinet approval rating drops to 59% in latest poll
stories.summary: The approval rate for PM Takaichi's cabinet fell 4.5 percentage points to 59.3% in March, the lowest since her inauguration last October. The decline followed revelations about gift catalog distributions to LDP lawmakers.

articles.title: Approval rate for Takaichi's Cabinet drops to 59%: poll

stories.headline: Takaichi backs education minister despite extramarital affair report
stories.summary: PM Takaichi indicated she will retain Education Minister Yohei Matsumoto despite a reported extramarital affair. Takaichi said she asked him to assume the post as a specialist in educational administration and wants him to 'repay us through work.'

articles.title: Takaichi backs education minister after affair report

stories.headline: Emperor Naruhito and family attend baseball game, plan Europe visit
stories.summary: Emperor Naruhito, Empress Masako and Princess Aiko attended Japan's World Baseball Classic game against Australia, marking the first time a sitting Japanese monarch has attended a professional baseball game since 1966. The imperial couple is also preparing to visit Netherlands and Belgium in June.

stories.headline: Takaichi pushes constitutional revision and defense capability strengthening
stories.summary: PM Takaichi is leveraging her electoral mandate to revise Japan's pacifist constitution and strengthen defense capabilities. She delivered a speech at the National Defense Academy pledging to 'drastically strengthen' defense capabilities without excluding any option.

articles.title: Japan's Sanae Takaichi Pushes to Revise Pacifist Constitution
Takaichi vows to bolster Japan's defense capabilities
VOX POPULI: Is Japan truly prepared to undo its 'final bastion' of pacifist ideals?

stories.headline: Takaichi states Iran conflict not 'survival-threatening situation' for Japan
stories.summary: PM Takaichi said the Iran war does not constitute a 'survival-threatening situation' under Japan's security legislation, a designation that would allow Self-Defense Forces deployment. She also said Japan has no plans to send minesweepers to the Middle East.

articles.title: Can the U.S. ask for Japan's help in the Iran war?
Japan not planning to send minesweepers to Middle East, Takaichi says

stories.headline: Japan thanks South Korea for evacuating Japanese nationals from Saudi Arabia
stories.summary: PM Takaichi thanked the South Korean government for flying three Japanese nationals out of Saudi Arabia on its military transport aircraft amid rising tensions over Iran. She said this represents bilateral cooperation to help protect citizens in third countries.

articles.title: Takaichi thanks S.Korea for transporting Japanese nationals from Saudi Arabia

stories.headline: Japan marks 15th anniversary of tsunami disaster as Takaichi promotes nuclear energy
stories.summary: Japan marked the 15th anniversary of the 2011 earthquake, tsunami and nuclear disaster. PM Takaichi attended a ceremony in Fukushima and has pushed to accelerate reactor restarts and promote nuclear power as a stable energy source.

stories.headline: G7 nations coordinate on potential emergency oil reserves release
stories.summary: G7 finance and energy ministers held multiple meetings to discuss coordinated release of strategic oil reserves amid surging crude prices. While initially hesitant, the group expressed readiness to take 'necessary measures' and announced support for potential joint action with the IEA.

stories.headline: Japan deploys Type-12 missiles near East China Sea in response to China tensions
stories.summary: Japan has deployed its domestically produced Type-12 long-range surface-to-ship missiles near the East China Sea. The upgraded missiles can be deployed from multiple platforms including ground launchers, ships and aircraft, significantly expanding JSDF operational flexibility.
